description: Smart Legal Object Layer — open standard for zero-identity on-chain legal agreements

NDA.description: Non-disclosure agreement between two or more parties

GovernanceDecision.description: DAO governance vote or proposal agreement

WhistleblowerAgreement.description: Anonymous agreement between journalist and source

InheritanceDirective.description: On-chain asset transfer and inheritance instruction

on_chain_representation.contract_hash: SHA-256 of agreement content — 32 bytes stored on-chain via Anchor program
on_chain_representation.key_commitment: Pedersen hash of signer biometric key — proves identity without revealing it
on_chain_representation.signature_commitment: Pedersen hash of (signer_key, contract_hash, timestamp) — non-repudiable proof of signing
on_chain_representation.multisig_threshold: M-of-N threshold stored in MultiSigContract account
on_chain_representation.timestamp: Unix timestamp of signing — anchored on Solana
